title: Sleeve bag filters
description: Filter bags for dust separation systems — pulse-jet, reverse-air and shaker systems with long service life.
paragraphs: We manufacture and supply filter bags using modern finishing technologies that are well suited to all types of dust separation systems (pulse-jet, reverse-air or shaker systems).

Thanks to the selection of high-quality nonwoven technical fabrics with various surface treatments, our filter bags offer a long service life with optimal filtration performance and low pressure drop.
